resources.string: "“Storm cell to the SW” tells where the cell lies relative to you. “Moving NE” tells where the cell is travelling to. Estimated arrival means getting within 8 km if the current movement continues during the next hour."
"the level will rise in the next hour"
"change within 1 cm relative to mean sea level"
"the level will fall in the next hour"
"less than 6 s, waves from local wind"
"10 s or more, waves from afar"
"On opening, only the saved model and ensemble are verified. Verify another model by tapping it; only a verified model can be selected."

"One shared list of regular and sea tiles. The tick sets visibility, the arrows set the order. Sea tiles are shown only when sea data is turned on and usable data are available; they remember their place in the order."
"Tiles on the Now screen are arranged in pairs in this order. An available sea tile fills the space next to a regular one; at most one empty space remains at the end of the grid."

"One shared list of regular and sea tiles. The tick sets visibility; drag the handle on the left and drop it in a new place. Sea tiles are shown only when sea data is turned on and usable data are available; they remember their place in the order."
"Export saves locations and their order, models and location sources, units, display and tile order, chart settings and custom charts into one JSON file. API keys are not exported."
"The file is not a valid Perun app backup."
"Replace deletes the current settings and uses the backup. Merge keeps whatever is missing from the backup. The app then restarts."
"Weather cache, system permissions and API keys. The backup is versioned; an older version of the app may not accept a newer backup."
